title: The ReAct Pattern: How Your AI Agent Actually Thinks #techtok #aiagents
description:
Every modern AI agent runs on the same loop under the hood. Once you know it, debugging any agent takes thirty seconds.

The pattern is called ReAct, which stands for Reason and Act. Three steps that repeat until the task is complete.

The agent reasons first. It looks at the task and decides what to do next. Then it acts by calling a tool, searching the web, querying a database, or sending an email. Then it observes the result to determine whether it worked and what came back. Then it loops back to reasoning and starts again.
That cycle runs until the task is finished or the agent decides to stop.

Knowing this pattern makes troubleshooting straightforward. Agent stuck in a loop means the reasoning step is failing. Agent doing the wrong thing means the act step is failing. Agent ignoring results means the observe step is failing. 

You stop guessing and fix the right thing immediately.
